name: The Westcliff, Four Seasons Hotel Johannesburg
positioning: Low-rise hillside hotel with villas and landscaped gardens in Johannesburg
best_for: Families wanting a two-bedroom room with interconnecting bedrooms
Guests who want a spa day with an outdoor spa lounge
Travelers using Johannesburg as a starting point for a safari

facts.text: The hotel is at 67 Jan Smuts Avenue in Johannesburg.
The low-rise buildings are surrounded by eight acres (three hectares) of landscaped gardens and courtyards.
The hotel has nine sun-splashed villas woven with courtyards, fountains and gardens.
Flames has an iconic terrace perched high above Johannesburg's urban forest.
The spa lap pool is a 25-metre (82-foot) adults-only pool.
The hotel has an outdoor family pool.
The location is a central starting point for safaris and exploration in South Africa and beyond.
Spa facilities and treatments are open every day, 9:00 am – 7:00 pm.

highlights.text: Après-Spa is the city's only outdoor spa lounge.
The Three-Bedroom Royal Suite has an oversized living room with a marble fireplace.
The Two-Bedroom Family Room offers two interconnecting bedrooms and is located near the family pool.
The signature Westcliff Breakfast is served at The View, overlooking Johannesburg's most iconic vista.
The Concierge can plan a safari to view Africa's big five at Kruger National Park.

considerations.text: OR Tambo International Airport is 30–45 minutes by car from the hotel.
The hotel is on the Witwatersrand, the rocky hills that run through the city.
WhataHotel notes the hotel requires transportation to downtown attractions.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
